title: Native delivery authority and atomic exact-SHA terminal truth
summary: Quarantine the live Taskplane per-agent stage/execution-root dispatch path, reuse Codex as the sole native execution authority, enforce one Design-only quick all-26 signal and zero execution-time lenses, tighten native telemetry and bounded handoffs, prove real-checkout wiring, and logically publish all exact-SHA terminal projections through one immutable bundle and CAS head.

current_state.summary: At pinned SHA 27ab9fecad3cf3b477e02678f6fa4d9ec721f54e, Plan topology and BUILD-C already express dependency/disjoint-scope intent, delivery_policy already has zero-lens primitives, and dispatch_telemetry already has closed identities and human ceilings. The native-authority boundary is nevertheless incomplete: loop.wave calls _stage_loop_wave_dispatches, which uses StageLifecycle split/resume and per-agent execution-root claims and emits stage_runtime_dispatch. Execution Evaluate/EM still traverse ReviewKernel/lens coverage, active usage may be null and is omitted from budget totals, hook ingestion swallows telemetry failures, wiring_closure proves selector shape rather than actual candidate reachability, and no coordinator atomically reconciles terminal sources on one SHA.
evidence_limitations: knowledge.current_state is null; this bounded inventory uses the amended Product spec, exact-tip committed sources, exact-tip tests, the isolated baseline graph, and the installed native-dispatch reference.
The currently observed Codex collaboration capacity is 13 total slots including root. It is dynamic host evidence, not a constant, admission rule, reservation count, or Taskplane authority.

The one quick concurrent all-26 Design sweep ran exactly once against provisional content fingerprint 40db587023b4f0494800b3494114dd68264a69131a87f53e2ad9dc9aaa26a236. Its 26 unique results are retained under design/lens-evidence and every finding is dispositioned in this final Design candidate.

decision: Select native-adapter-quarantine. Codex exclusively owns spawn, dynamic capacity/admission, the agent tree, message/follow-up/interrupt transport, completion/attention, event waiting and lifecycle facts. Taskplane retains pure dependency/scope classification, contract and budget refusal, worktree preparation, checkpoints and evidence observation. Remove _stage_loop_wave_dispatches and every per-agent stage split/resume/execution-root projection from native dispatch; retain StageLifecycle only as phase/gate/evidence journal. Add narrow validators and one logical exact-SHA terminal bundle rather than a scheduler, queue, service or database.

receipt_contracts.evolution: Authority receipts are closed objects and unknown schema ids fail closed. Compatibility is governed by receipt_compatibility; a breaking authority change requires a new schema id, dual-read deployment when a predecessor is retained, and automated predecessor/current fixtures.

rules.additive: Only explicitly optional fields may be added within a schema id; existing required-field meaning and authority may not change.
rules.breaking: Any required-field, semantic, authority, error, or fingerprint change requires a new schema id.
rules.unknown_fields: Authority readers reject unknown fields unless that exact schema table marks additive optional-field tolerance.
rules.deployment: Consumers dual-read every listed predecessor before a new producer writes current receipts; producer deploys second; old write support retires only after retained active runs and compatibility fixtures prove no predecessor producer remains.
rules.history: Immutable historical receipts remain readable through their named predecessor reader and never gain new authority by conversion.

native_dispatch.ready_set_rule: Compute and seal once. build_c.assign_scopes consumes the sealed members/fingerprint and only prepares worktrees/contracts; it does not reclassify or truncate by host capacity.
native_dispatch.budget_screen: Each attempted native start is atomically bound to a finite non-null usage observation and checked against AC6. Budget refusal is contract governance, not host capacity or scheduling.
native_dispatch.wait_rule: After native start attempts, one event-driven wait covers exactly the host-accepted outstanding set and receives an absolute child deadline strictly before the eight-hour wave deadline. Completion or native attention is the normal wake. If transport is silent at the child deadline, the host returns exactly one attributed NATIVE_WAIT_DEADLINE attention carrying run/task/outstanding-set/elapsed/usage identities, stops for human scope review, and never polls, reissues, replaces, or schedules work automatically.
native_dispatch.deadline_rule: deadline_at is min(wave_started_at + 28800 seconds - reconciliation_reserve_seconds, the earliest accepted child contract deadline); reconciliation_reserve_seconds is positive and sealed by Plan. A missing/non-finite deadline refuses the wait.
native_dispatch.stage_rule: No call or data edge from native dispatch to StageLifecycle split/resume, execution-root claim, _stage_bindings or stage_runtime_dispatch.

budget_and_handoff.comparison: Every value must be finite, non-negative and strictly below its ceiling before a native start. Equality, breach or missing value yields human_scope_review and no silent continuation.

actions.consequence: close the current dispatch set without replacement and create a separately authorized successor wave
terminalize the current wave as stopped with immutable evidence
preserve place and return to an attributed architecture/scope decision before any new dispatch

human_scope_checkpoint.resume_rule: No action resumes the stopped dispatch set silently; any successor start receives new explicit authority and a fresh budget observation.

budget_and_handoff.active_usage: A start observation supplies finite zero-or-greater provider counters, so observed_tokens is never null. Aggregates include current active observations and finalized receipts exactly once.
budget_and_handoff.cycle_rule: A second failed Fix/Evaluate cycle stops for a human architecture or scope decision.

wiring_closure.real_checkout_rule: The positive suite runs in the registered pinned/final checkout at exact HEAD. Test files and production files must be Git-tracked blobs at that HEAD. A severed proof may use a separately registered sibling Git worktree at the same commit with exactly one declared edge mutation. Arbitrary temporary directories, copied/generated sources, generated selector files, opaque fingerprints and foreign repository identities are refused.
wiring_closure.execution_rule: Every acceptance selector and named producer edge executes at pinned SHA and final candidate SHA. Each clean selector passes; the same exact production selector fails in the one-edge mutation worktree. Receipt identity and all result bytes are content-addressed.

terminal_finalization.surface_cardinality_rule: There are exactly eight projections and exports_terminal_evidence is one of the eight. No ninth projection exists outside surface_ids; every digest set, writer, reader, reconciler, and test derives cardinality from this enumeration.
terminal_finalization.prepare: Validate a clean exact candidate and every prerequisite; create and fsync immutable content-addressed bytes for exactly the eight surface_ids, including the redacted exports_terminal_evidence projection. Prepared bytes carry no terminal authority.

finalization_authority.capability: A non-serializable orchestrator object-capability bound to run_id, full candidate SHA, approved Design fingerprint, approved Plan fingerprint, expected predecessor and operation id; it is created only inside the root finalization command and is never written to a brief, receipt, environment variable, candidate checkout, test process, or worker scope.
finalization_authority.write_isolation: The immutable bundle/head authority store is outside candidate and worker writable scopes. Worker and candidate-test processes receive read-only prerequisite adapters and no filesystem/API handle capable of creating bundles or advancing head.json.
finalization_authority.validation: commit_delivery requires the live object-capability, exact bound identities, root operation identity, unchanged predecessor, clean checkout, and complete prepared digest set. A structurally valid bundle from any task/worker/test identity is refused before the authority store is opened for write.

terminal_finalization.commit: Under one orchestrator-only finalization capability and lock, revalidate HEAD/clean tree and expected predecessor, verify every prepared digest, fsync the bundle directory, and CAS one head.json to the immutable bundle. All surface readers require that head and the complete eight-digest set; no individual legacy projection is terminal authority.
terminal_finalization.reconcile: Normal reconciliation reads the indexed head and its direct predecessor, validates lineage, and checks only projections marked missing or dirty in the content-addressed projection index. It rejects fork/gap/collision/mixed SHA, restores derived projections from exact immutable bytes, clears dirty entries only after byte-identical verification, and returns the same bundle for repeated commit. Prior bytes are never overwritten.

reconciliation_bounds.online_scope: current head, direct predecessor, and the at-most-eight missing-or-dirty projection ids for the current bundle
reconciliation_bounds.index: content-addressed head/predecessor checkpoint plus per-bundle dirty projection bitmap, itself covered by the bundle/reconciliation receipt fingerprints
reconciliation_bounds.offline_audit: An explicit non-terminal, read-only offline audit may scan the full immutable history; it is never on the delivery critical path and cannot advance terminal authority.

terminal_finalization.atomicity: A crash before CAS exposes no terminal authority. A crash after CAS may leave a derived copy absent, but global read remains nonterminal until reconciliation restores every digest; no reader may claim terminal from an individual surface.

operator_states.meaning: Prerequisites and eight immutable projection bytes are being validated; no terminal authority exists.
The authorized root is fsyncing the bundle and attempting one head CAS; no individual surface is authoritative.
The head exists but one or more derived projections require byte-identical restoration; global terminal reads and delivery claims remain blocked.
All eight digests and native aggregate are readable and a reconciliation receipt exists.
A named boundary failed; the last trustworthy candidate, immutable bytes, private telemetry, error code, and retryability are preserved.

terminal_finalization.integration_rule: Feature task merges create the candidate and are not final delivery claims. After finalization, merge to main must preserve the exact SHA by fast-forward; any SHA-changing merge invalidates the bundle and requires a fresh candidate/finalization. Push/tag/publish/release remain unauthorized in this wave even when local terminal truth is complete.
terminal_finalization.exports_rule: Write only a redacted ignored checkout-resident projection under exports/terminal/r0013/<full-sha>.json so the candidate Git tree stays clean and avoids a SHA self-reference. It is authoritative only through the terminal bundle CAS, never by path or contents alone.
terminal_finalization.privacy_rule: Detailed per-session usage remains private until a successful taskplane.terminal-reconciliation/v1 receipt proves all eight surface digests and the native aggregate readable and consistent. Only then may the terminal-truth owner run idempotent deletion or irreversible minimization and emit taskplane.private-usage-cleanup/v1. Reconciliation or cleanup failure preserves the private detail for retry and emits no cleanup receipt. The immutable aggregate remains for replay verification; exports contains aggregate counters and non-content identities/fingerprints only.

failure_modes.detection: registered Git checkout and tracked-blob identity signal
failure_modes.recovery: Refuse checkpoint/finalization; execute the named selector and one-edge mutation again in the actual pinned/final checkout.

failure_modes.recovery: Refuse before opening the authority store for write; preserve the attempted bundle fingerprint and request attributed security attention.

failure_modes.recovery: Keep the operator state failed or reconciling, preserve private detail and immutable aggregate, and allow only the same idempotent reconciliation/cleanup retry.

failure_modes.recovery: Refuse merge/push/tag/publish/release claim; fast-forward the exact SHA or produce and validate a new candidate bundle under separate human authority.

observability.privacy: Persist only non-content identities/fingerprints, bounded native state/timestamps/durations and aggregate usage. Refuse or redact prompts, transcripts, source/diff/output bytes, secrets, credentials and free-text personal content.

risks.risk: Static forbidden-name checks miss renamed duplicate authority
risks.mitigation: Validate semantic reachability from the three native delivery roots and pair it with real packaged-mode spies and one-edge mutations.

risks.risk: Removing per-agent stage rows breaks historical stage readers
risks.mitigation: Keep StageLifecycle phase/gate/evidence journal readers and treat historical per-agent rows as read-only inventory; only new native dispatch production is quarantined.

risks.risk: Taskplane budget enforcement is mistaken for host admission
risks.mitigation: Emit every ready intent without capacity truncation; enforce only the human contract at each attempted native start and leave slot choice/start order to Codex.

risks.risk: Concurrent native starts race the session/token ceiling
risks.mitigation: The screen binds observation and checks/increments the private ledger under one evidence CAS; one start wins and equality refuses the next without reserving host capacity.

risks.risk: Real-checkout proof mutates or contaminates the clean candidate
risks.mitigation: Positive selectors run read-only in the clean candidate; edge mutation runs only in a separately registered same-commit Git worktree with one declared diff and scoped teardown.

risks.risk: Cross-filesystem writes cannot be physically atomic
risks.mitigation: Use immutable prepared bytes and one logical CAS authority head; all readers require the complete bundle, so partial derived copies never become terminal truth.

risks.risk: Ignored exports projection is mistaken for standalone authority
risks.mitigation: Projection schema carries terminal bundle fingerprint and explicitly has no authority without the managed-run CAS head and full digest validation.

risks.risk: Terminal capability leaks into worker or test scope
risks.mitigation: Use a non-serializable root object-capability, omit it from every handoff/receipt/environment, isolate authority-store writes, and run an unauthorized-valid-bundle negative selector.

risks.risk: Private usage is destroyed before post-CAS recovery is proven
risks.mitigation: Require a successful exactly-eight-surface reconciliation receipt before idempotent cleanup; any failure preserves private detail and emits no cleanup receipt.

risks.risk: Seven acceptance leaves still collide in loop.py/tp.py
risks.mitigation: Forbid leaf edits to shared adapters and serialize one narrow integration owner after all seven typed leaf-readiness receipts, then run AC7 end-to-end only after the integration receipt.

rollout.strategy: First close and test the three new pure owners plus existing leaf owners in one native disjoint wave, producing all seven taskplane.acceptance-leaf-readiness/v1 receipts. Then run one shared-adapter integration task that depends on those receipts, removes stage-native per-agent authority, connects zero-lens, sealed-ready-set, budget and finalization APIs, and emits taskplane.integration-readiness/v1. AC7 end-to-end validation follows that receipt. Execute focused positive/negative tests, actual pinned-checkout wiring and edge mutations, the final-checkout repeat, atomic fault matrix and finally python3 -m pytest taskplane/tests -q. Feature tasks may integrate to form the candidate; final delivery claims require one exact-SHA terminal bundle. No push/tag/publication/release occurs in this wave.
rollout.rollback: Before final CAS, remove a thin adapter with its owner and return to the last green candidate while retaining immutable evidence. Stage journal compatibility remains. After CAS, never rewrite a bundle or projection: disable the adapter, create a new candidate SHA and append a successor bundle. Legacy individual reports remain readable but cannot regain terminal authority, and the retired per-agent native dispatch path is not a rollback target.
